references.text: Parallel list of unclean birds in Deuteronomy, which also mentions the owl, pelican, and birds of prey among the unclean birds that the Israelites were not to eat.
Isaiah mentions the pelican (קָאָת) and the owl as dwelling in desolate Edom, showing these birds' association with wasteland and uncleanness.
Zephaniah prophesies that the pelican (קָאָת) will dwell among the ruins of Nineveh, using this unclean bird as a symbol of destruction.
The psalmist compares himself to a pelican (קָאָת) in the wilderness, one of the unclean birds mentioned in Leviticus 11:18.
